notes: Single sample: SuCasΩ + crRNA expressed from plasmids (IPTG + L-arabinose) to map crRNA processing. Library made with the NEBNext Small RNA kit after PNK 3'-end repair (adapter ligation to RNA ends, mapped to the crRNA locus) -> assay_class small_rna; unsure between small_rna and end_mapping, either way not standard RNA-seq. Host strain not named. The control-plasmid culture is not among the candidates, so is_control left out.
